description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hetthetiya East, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820004 and other title settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in Matara District. It contains detailed schedules listing parcel numbers, extents, owner names, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
